title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: Jesus' teachings and miracles draw large crowds.

title: Pete's Meteor
description: Lives change for members of an Irish family after a meteor crashes in their backyard.

title: Hush
description: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

title: Good Fences
description: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.
An Italian film director (Marcello Mastroianni) seeking the meaning of life retreats from his wife (Anouk Aimée), mistress and flatterers.

title: Language Lessons
description: When Adam's husband surprises him with weekly Spanish lessons, he's unsure about where or how this new element will fit into his already structured life. However, when tragedy strikes, his teacher becomes a lifeline he didn't know he needed.

title: Piranha
description: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

title: Triple 9
description: Criminals and some crooked cops hatch a devious scheme to use an honest lawman as a pawn for a heist.

title: Succubus
description: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: The Imposter
description: Filmmaker Bart Layton chronicles the tale of Frederic Bourdin, a con artist who seemingly tricked a Texas family into believing he was a relative who disappeared years earlier.

title: Two Thousand and None
description: After learning, he has only five weeks to live, a paleontologist begins to discover the joys of life.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: Charade
description: A suave stranger (Cary Grant) helps a chic widow (Audrey Hepburn) stalked by four men looking for loot in Paris.

title: The Rising Hawk
description: During the 13th century, a small village fights for freedom in the frontier landscape of the Carpathian Mountains against Mongolian invaders.

title: Bloodfist II
description: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

title: The TV Set
description: A network picks up Mike Klein's (David Duchovny) pilot for a TV series, and now he must navigate through one incompetent executive after another, hoping the concept of the show still bears some resemblance to his original idea.

title: Road Games
description: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

title: The Last Seduction
description: An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

title: Metroland
description: Urging a bohemian existence, a former schoolmate disrupts a London couple's conventional lifestyle.

title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
description: An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.

title: The Warrior's Way
description: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, a master swordsman (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town.

title: Rough Magic
description: A sleazy politician sends an agent (Russell Crowe) after his ex-fiancee (Bridget Fonda), who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: Honest Thief
description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

title: The Loft
description: Paranoia grips a group of married men (Karl Urban, James Marsden, Wentworth Miller) who find the dead body of an unknown woman in the penthouse they share for extramarital trysts.

title: Labyrinth
description: Teenage Sarah (Jennifer Connelly) journeys through a maze to recover her baby brother (Toby Froud) from a goblin king (David Bowie).

title: The Road to Wellville
description: Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
description: Pop-culture satires include "Cleopatra Schwartz," "A Fistful of Yen" and "Catholic High-School Girls in Trouble."

title: Nosferatu
description: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

title: The Commitments
description: An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.

title: Silver City
description: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

title: Hitman
description: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

title: Infernal Affairs II
description: In this prequel to the original, a rebel policeman sets up the infiltration of Triad gangs and tries to bring down a corrupt cop working for the Triad boss.

title: A Room With a View
description: An English miss (Helena Bonham-Carter) tours 1907 Florence, Italy, with her cousin (Maggie Smith) and meets a soulmate (Julian Sands).

title: Battle Beyond the Stars
description: Shad of Akir (Richard Thomas) recruits a space cowboy (George Peppard) and other warriors to defend his planet from a barbarian's army.

title: Sophie's Choice
description: A Southern writer (Peter MacNicol) lives in Brooklyn with an Auschwitz survivor (Meryl Streep) and her mad lover (Kevin Kline).

title: Black Sabbath
description: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

title: Infernal Affairs
description: A troubled officer (Tony Leung) under deep cover and a corrupt cop (Andy Lau) each try to divine the other's identity within a crime lord's organization.

title: Basquiat
description: Self-destructiveness and disdain for the middle class mark the life of artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, dead of an overdose in 1988.
